<?php
// gRPC service handler for document processing pipeline
// Uses ReactPHP for async operations

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use React\EventLoop\LoopInterface;

class DocumentProcessorService
{
    private $loop;
    private $maxFileSize;
    private $tempDir;
    private $compressionRatioThreshold;
    private $maxDecompressedSize;
    private $activeStreams = [];

    public function __construct(LoopInterface $loop, array $config = [])
    {
        $this->loop = $loop;
        $this->maxFileSize = $config['max_file_size'] ?? 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
        $this->tempDir = $config['temp_dir'] ?? sys_get_temp_dir();
        $this->compressionRatioThreshold = $config['compression_ratio_threshold'] ?? 100;
        $this->maxDecompressedSize = $config['max_decompressed_size'] ?? 100 * 1024 * 1024;
    }

    /**
     * gRPC handler: ProcessArchive
     * Accepts a streaming upload of a zip archive and processes contained documents
     */
    public function processArchive($call): PromiseInterface
    {
        return $this->receiveStream($call)
            ->then([$this, 'validateArchive'])
            ->then([$this, 'extractAndProcess'])
            ->then([$this, 'buildResponse']);
    }

    private function receiveStream($call): PromiseInterface
    {
        $deferred = new \React\Promise\Deferred();
        $buffer = '';
        $totalReceived = 0;

        $call->on('data', function ($chunk) use (&$buffer, &$totalReceived, $deferred) {
            $totalReceived += strlen($chunk->getPayload());
            if ($totalReceived > $this->maxFileSize) {
                $deferred->reject(new \RuntimeException('Upload exceeds maximum file size'));
                return;
            }
            $buffer .= $chunk->getPayload();
        });

        $call->on('end', function () use (&$buffer, $deferred) {
            $tmpFile = tempnam($this->tempDir, 'grpc_upload_');
            file_put_contents($tmpFile, $buffer);
            $deferred->resolve($tmpFile);
        });

        return $deferred->promise();
    }

    public function validateArchive(string $archivePath): string
    {
        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
        $result = $zip->open($archivePath, \ZipArchive::RDONLY);
        if ($result !== true) {
            @unlink($archivePath);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid ZIP archive');
        }

        $totalUncompressed = 0;
        $archiveSize = filesize($archivePath);

        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $stat = $zip->statIndex($i);
            $totalUncompressed += $stat['size'];

            // Check individual file compression ratio
            if ($stat['comp_size'] > 0) {
                $ratio = $stat['size'] / $stat['comp_size'];
                if ($ratio > $this->compressionRatioThreshold) {
                    $zip->close();
                    @unlink($archivePath);
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Suspicious compression ratio detected');
                }
            }
        }

        // Check total decompressed size against threshold
        if ($totalUncompressed > $this->maxDecompressedSize) {
            $zip->close();
            @unlink($archivePath);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Total decompressed size exceeds limit');
        }

        $zip->close();
        return $archivePath;
    }

    public function extractAndProcess(string $archivePath): array
    {
        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
        $zip->open($archivePath, \ZipArchive::RDONLY);

        $extractDir = $this->tempDir . '/extract_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        mkdir($extractDir, 0700, true);

        $results = [];
        $cumulativeSize = 0;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $stat = $zip->statIndex($i);
            $entryName = $stat['name'];

            // Skip directories
            if (substr($entryName, -1) === '/') {
                continue;
            }

            // Extract using stream to monitor actual decompressed bytes
            $stream = $zip->getStream($entryName);
            if (!$stream) {
                continue;
            }

            $outPath = $extractDir . '/' . basename($entryName);
            $outHandle = fopen($outPath, 'wb');
            $bytesWritten = 0;

            while (!feof($stream)) {
                $chunk = fread($stream, 8192);
                $bytesWritten += strlen($chunk);
                $cumulativeSize += strlen($chunk);

                // Runtime decompression bomb check using cumulative across ALL files
                if ($cumulativeSize > $this->maxDecompressedSize) {
                    fclose($stream);
                    fclose($outHandle);
                    $this->cleanup($extractDir, $archivePath);
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Decompression bomb detected at runtime');
                }

                fwrite($outHandle, $chunk);
            }

            fclose($stream);
            fclose($outHandle);

            $results[] = $this->processDocument($outPath);
        }

        $zip->close();
        $this->cleanup($extractDir, $archivePath);
        return $results;
    }

    private function processDocument(string $filePath): array
    {
        $content = file_get_contents($filePath);
        return [
            'path' => basename($filePath),
            'size' => strlen($content),
            'hash' => hash('sha256', $content),
        ];
    }

    public function buildResponse(array $results): array
    {
        return [
            'status' => 'success',
            'documents_processed' => count($results),
            'results' => $results,
        ];
    }

    private function cleanup(string $extractDir, string $archivePath): void
    {
        $files = glob($extractDir . '/*');
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            @unlink($file);
        }
        @rmdir($extractDir);
        @unlink($archivePath);
    }
}
